summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Iteration 5 (LLM error classification, HEALTH · DIAGNOSTICS tab, BIG BANG · LAUNCH tab, security headers, login brute-force RL, PDF magic-byte). 14/14 backend pytest pass. All 11 frontend checks pass. LLM is HEALTHY in this run (live probe 2213ms, model claude-sonnet-4-5).

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The platform <select> options contain a child <span> tag, which is invalid HTML. Non-blocking (works fine) but should be fixed to silence the React warning. Likely in /app/frontend/src/components/LaunchCampaignPanel.jsx — wrap the platform label in plain text or move the icon outside the option.

critical_code_review_comments: classify_llm_error() centralisation is good — single source of truth for budget_exceeded/insufficient_balance/rate_limited/auth_failed/timeout. Error code surfaced via HTTPException.detail.code makes the axios interceptor + SSE error handling trivial.
SecurityHeadersMiddleware uses setdefault → correct, won't clobber existing headers, and applied via add_middleware so headers attach to ALL responses including 404s. Verified live.
In-memory rate limit (_RL_BUCKETS) is per-process. With multiple uvicorn workers it would be bypassable. Currently single-worker so fine, but worth a Redis-backed bucket if scaling out.
_client_key() uses X-Forwarded-For first hop. Behind k8s ingress this is correct; in a different reverse-proxy chain it could be spoofed. Consider trusted-proxy validation if exposed differently.
PDF magic-byte check is solid (%PDF prefix + denied-patterns /javascript /launch /embeddedfile). Good defense-in-depth.
server.py is now 3508 lines — past the 700-line recommendation. Consider splitting into routers (auth, leads, agents, admin, launch, health, security) for maintainability.

HealthPanel polls /api/admin/system-health every 30s and LlmHealthBanner polls /api/llm-health every 60s. Both are unauthenticated reads (llm-health) and authenticated (system-health). Public llm-health endpoint is zero-cost and safe.
seed_data_creation: None. Brute-force rate-limit test created 8-10 throwaway login attempts (cleared on backend restart). I restarted backend once via supervisorctl to clear the RL bucket so subsequent frontend login could succeed — important context for next agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login brute-force RL bucket is IP-keyed in-memory; running the rate-limit pytest will lock out subsequent logins from the same IP for ~5 min OR until backend restart. The pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py includes the RL test as the last item in TestSecurity so non-auth tests pass first. LLM was healthy in this run (probe 2213ms). All 5 social assets (mp3/mp4/jpg) are served by /api/launch/asset/{name} from /app/static/social/. Campaign endpoint is fully static, LLM-independent. Server.py is 3508 lines — main agent may want to split.
rca of the issue: No bugs. One cosmetic React warning surfaced in console (<span> inside <option> in PLATFORM filter) — flagged in action_items.
